disposition: ALL THREE ITEMS ARE REPORTED. No bar is set for any of them, and none is scored PASS or FAIL.
whyNoBars: A bar derived from the only measurement that exists is a bar fitted to its own data. Each item below states what would be needed to set one instead of inventing one here.

controlsApplied.drawComposition: Both stills classified with scripts/draw-composition.mjs before any appearance number was quoted. Both regions read 0.0000 procedural massing and 1.000 surface, so both are ADMISSIBLE: these are readings of drawn tier geometry, not of the massing fallback. T006 published a 0.008 per cent 'PASS' on a region that was 100 per cent massing in both arms, which is why this check runs first and not last.
controlsApplied.regionAndCoordinateSpace: The region is the centre half of the CANVAS, converted to IMAGE coordinates by adding the canvas origin. T006 invalidated a whole campaign by applying canvas-space regions to whole-window captures; the origin is recorded with every reading here.
controlsApplied.pickControl: NOT RUN for these two items, and that is a limitation rather than an omission: both are whole-scene appearance readings over a canvas-centre region, not claims about a NAMED building, so there is no single feature id for a pick to confirm. Any future claim about a specific tile's appearance would need one.

brightLuminance.pose: T005 pose registry P2, oblique 2,400 m over Midtown
brightLuminance.whyNoBar: The only prior characterisation of far-tier tone is EEVEE, and EEVEE is not the shipped renderer. Setting an in-app bar here would mean inventing an error budget for a brand-new in-app instrument in the same act that uses it -- which is what T006 honest-stopped over.
brightLuminance.namedMissingCapability: A forced-LOD and isolation hook: render a named tile at a chosen level, alone, from a camera the measurement picks rather than the ring dictates. Without it, tile appearance cannot be separated from everything drawn around it.

honestStopCellAppearance.item: Appearance over an honest-stop cell (one of the 43 the bake refused)
honestStopCellAppearance.pose: T005 pose registry P3, nadir 1,600 m over a cell the bake honest-stopped
honestStopCellAppearance.observation: Three dense-massing buildings are active at this pose (massingActive 3) while 839 far-tier cells draw. The centre-half region reads 0.0000 procedural massing, so those three sit outside it. The scene over an honest-stop cell is materially darker than the P2 far-tier scene -- surface mean luminance 0.156 against 0.360 -- which is consistent with a nadir view of ground and low roofs rather than a lit oblique cityscape, and is NOT offered as a defect.
honestStopCellAppearance.whyNoBar: Nothing in the project states what an honest-stop cell SHOULD look like. It is a cell the bake refused; the runtime's contract is that it draws massing there rather than nothing, and that contract is a count, not an appearance.

loadTimes.warmCacheCaveat: THESE ARE WARM-CACHE READINGS AND MUST NOT BE COMPARED WITH T005's. T005 measured a first far-tier attribute at 4,511-7,529 ms on a cold load; 195 and 199 ms here reflect a browser that has already fetched all 839 tiles at these poses several times during this campaign. The number is real and the condition is stated; it is not a speedup.
loadTimes.whyNoBar: A bar would have to come from a stated product requirement about how long a user may wait. No such requirement exists in this project, and deriving one from this campaign's own two readings would be fitting a bar to its own data.

nonClaims: REPORTED means measured and published, not accepted.
One machine, one session, AC power, warm cache where stated.
Neither still is evidence that the tiers look right; a screenshot cannot carry an appearance verdict, and no appearance verdict is offered.
